overal.goal: No '#' in the web UI's URLs (owner, 2026-10-30): replace the hash router (packages/web/ui/src/lib/route.ts, useRoute.ts: #/p/<pid>/tasks/...) with path-based routing (/p/<pid>/tasks/...) using the History API. The server must answer the UI's index.html for every UI path (SPA fallback) while /api/*, /mcp, /healthz and the docs files keep their own routes. It must keep working under a reverse-proxy path prefix (/boof/ behind nginx, X-Forwarded-Prefix) and in the desktop app, and old #/ links (bookmarks, the README, notifications) must redirect to the new paths.
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono server, React + Vite UI (shadcn/ui on Tailwind v4), vitest

rules.do: Read README.md, docs/boof-runner.md and docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-27-ui-redesign-design.md before changing code.
Write a failing test first where the change is logic (src/lib, server); keep the change focused on this goal.
Run `npm run typecheck && npx prettier --check . && npx vitest run && npm run build:server` before finishing.
Keep every UI URL relative to the base the server is mounted under; derive the base from the page's location or X-Forwarded-Prefix, never assume '/'.
Redirect old hash links (#/p/<pid>/...) to the matching path on load.
rules.dont: Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.
Do not break the token gate, the first-run gate or live updates.

versions.version: Requested by the owner on 2026-10-30; not started.

tests.strategy: Unit tests for parse/format of path routes and the hash-to-path redirect; server tests for the SPA fallback next to /api, /mcp and docs routes; a browser check under the /boof/ prefix and at the root.
